title: Preflight
description: Response body of GET /preflight. The client maps the InfraInfo fields onto its InfraInfo type (client/src/lib/runner/contract.ts) and stashes `capabilities` for transport negotiation. The server serves/sinks raw bytes; this document carries no rates.

clientIp.description: The client's public IP as observed by the server (X-Forwarded-For first hop, else the socket remote address).

preTestPingMs.description: Optional server-side pre-test RTT hint in ms. 0 when no ping endpoint has run yet (e.g. Stage 1).

protocolNegotiated.description: The HTTP protocol this preflight response was served over, e.g. "http/1.1", "h2", "h3".

capabilities.description: What this server currently supports, so the client negotiates rather than assumes.

origins.description: Externally-reachable origins the client should target per transport. Env-driven so the values are correct behind a reverse proxy. `null` means that origin is not enabled.

tls.description: HTTP/1.1+TLS origin (e.g. https://host:8443); null until enabled.

h3.description: HTTP/3 + WebTransport origin (e.g. https://host:8443); null until enabled.

transports.description: Which client-side transports this server can currently service. Honest per build stage.

endpoints.description: Stable endpoint paths, advertised so the client never hardcodes them.

uploadSession.description: HTTP endpoint that mints an opaque upload-session token during upload warmup. The client echoes that token as ?id= on POST /upload and GET /ws/upload for that upload stage.

wsUpload.description: WebSocket upload-progress bus: streams server-measured BYTES_RECEIVED/UPLOAD_COMPLETE for the test ?id=.
